Image Report on a Rising Hero.name: Image Report on a Rising Hero
Image Report on a Rising Hero.questStatement: After Hosu, every channel argued about heroes: who got the credit, who earned it, and whether the Hero Killer had a point. Principal Nezu sets the Management Course a real assignment: choose one working pro, study how the public sees them now and write an image report their agency could use. That means interviews on the streets of central Tokyo, with the press, the fans and, if you can get near, the hero.
Image Report on a Rising Hero.mainObjective: Research a working pro's public image and deliver a report their agency could use.

completionCondition.query: The PC has interviewed the public and at least one person close to a pro hero in Tokyo, and delivered an image report on that hero to Principal Nezu.

Image Report on a Rising Hero.questDesignBrief: Investigative and talky. Good subjects by record name: Endeavor, credited for Hosu in the default and cold with the press; Mount Lady, hungry for fame; Kamui Woods; Best Jeanist, an image expert himself; Edgeshot. Agencies guard access, so a sidekick, a fan or a reporter may talk instead. Street interviews on Central Tokyo Streets show the year's mood: Stain's creed online, distrust of heroes, love for All Might. Report on what the story has actually established about Hosu. Failure: a shallow report earns one polite, devastating question from Nezu, and a leaked draft starts a public spat.
